_about: The five region templates the map generator rolls from (SPEC.md › Map, Art direction). Order is play order: strip is the start, citadel the endgame behind a Boss Gate. `neighbours` is the region graph the generator bridges (`map.bridgesPerPair` bridge hexes per pair). `tiles` are weights for the hexes left over after the guaranteed tiles (inn, shop, graveyard, bloodbank, chaos, `map.chestsPerRegion` chests, one bossgate, one portal) are placed. `modifier.key` is what other modules switch on; the numbers behind them live in balance.json under `map`. `monsterTable` ids are species in data/monsters.json (owned by the encounters module); `bossId` is the region boss, `raidBossId` an optional raid. `voidFlavour` is the hex type of the impassable hexes drawn around and inside the cluster.

regions.name: Casino Strip

modifier.text: Where every run begins. The House is still friendly here.

regions.look: Rain-slick street of shuttered parlours, one sign still lit
regions.signature: The first Encounter is a drunk croupier revenant under the sign

regions.name: The Docks

modifier.text: Blood Pacts are cheaper on the pier; the Blood Banks stand on stilts.

regions.look: Drowned pier, lantern fog, Blood Banks on stilts
regions.signature: The loan shark is a shark

regions.name: Blackwood

modifier.text: Twice the Chaos tiles; the Chaos tiles are hanging trees.

regions.look: Gallows forest with dice hanging from the ropes

regions.name: The Caldera

modifier.text: Damage is doubled both ways in the forge-pit.

regions.look: Forge-pit casino, molten chips, salamander dealers
regions.signature: The Boss Gate is a furnace door

regions.name: Sky Citadel

modifier.text: Loot rolls one rarity higher; entry needs level 10 or a key. The throne is the Dealer's chair.

regions.look: Gilded high-roller tower above the clouds, cold gold
regions.signature: The throne is the Dealer's chair
